rows.en:
(I'm going shopping with
Yamashiro-sensei today!)
So you've come, \p.
Sorry, I'm a little late.

No matter.
Well then, shall we go?
Thank you for today.

No need for thanks, but was it really all
right for me to choose? It's a gift
for someone, isn't it?

Yes. I wanted someone as knowledgeable
as you to pick it, Sensei.
Hm, if that's the case, then fine...

Well then, I'll be heading home first.
Don't spend all your time playing around.

(Today I'm going shopping
with Yamashiro-sensei.)
I'm a little late. Sorry!

(I'm going shopping with
Yamashiro-sensei again today!)
There you are at last, \p.
Sorry I'm late!

Keeping your elders waiting
is hardly commendable...
...The lecture can wait. Let's go.

No need for thanks.
I enjoyed myself, too.
You sure bought a lot of things.

Well then, I'll be heading home first.
Once you're home, make sure you prepare
for and review your lessons properly.

(I'm going shopping with
Yamashiro-sensei again today~)

(I asked Yamashiro-sensei to let me run
the Battle Frontier's simulator!)
Did I keep you waiting, \p?

Then let's get going.
Are you ready?

Hm, you fight roughly, just like Gary.
Boldness is fine, but at this rate
you'll get seriously hurt someday.

You're not fighting alone.
Put a little more trust in your operators
and your wingmen.

If you were my operator, Sensei,
I'd be relying on you nonstop, though.
Flattery won't get you anything.
Now, let's tidy up and head home.
(That was another nice change of pace today.)

(I asked Yamashiro-sensei to let me run
the Battle Frontier's simulator.)

Hm, you fight roughly, just like Hilda.
Boldness is fine, but at this rate
you'll get seriously hurt someday.

If you were my operator, Sensei,
I'd rely on you, though.
(That was another nice change of pace today~)

My apologies for the wait,
\p.
I just got here myself, so it's fine.

Looks like you've improved a little.
You can afford to keep an eye
on your surroundings now.
You think so?

But it's at times like this that carelessness
and openings creep in.
Keep your focus up at all times.
Roger that!
I just got here too, so don't worry.
Aha, really?
(That was a good day.)

(I'm going to see a movie with
Yamashiro-sensei today!)
Sorry to keep you waiting, \p.
rows.notes: Also Kagura (frd_kgr_109) and, in frd_itk_116, Yamashiro; frd_itk_103 also reuses it mid-scene and once under an empty name plate. Kept as the plain apology.

rows.en: No, I only just got here myself.

Hm, is that so...
Then let's head to the theater.
That was quite an interesting film.

Its approach of paying homage to past
classics at every turn will probably
divide opinion, though...

Huh? Were there parts that paid
homage to something?
...Honestly, what were you even watching...

...Well, fine.
I'll explain it all at length over a meal.

That's why you went to the trouble
of inviting me, isn't it?

(I came to see a movie with
Yamashiro-sensei today.)
No, I only just got here myself.

(I'm going to see a movie with
Yamashiro-sensei again today!)
You're late, \p.
S-sorry!

...Well, fine.
Let's go see the movie, then.

Watching an action movie isn't bad at all.
Movies should be entertainment,
after all.
Yes, that was exhilarating!

But just because it's an action movie
doesn't mean you can watch it
without thinking.

Then I'll explain it over a meal again today.
Let's go, \p.

(I'm going to see a movie with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)
Yes, it was so thrilling and exciting!

uncertain: c06537 'Sorry to keep you waiting, \p.' is shared by Yamashiro (frd_itk_103, frd_itk_116) and Kagura (frd_kgr_109); frd_itk_103 repeats it mid-scene and once under an empty name plate after the player's 'Yes!' (looks like a script reuse; translated the same).
c06538 (player male / Luca in frd_luk_109) and c06547 (player female / Shirakawa in frd_myk_104) both 'No, I only just got here myself.'
c06498 'Thank you for today.' is also Luca's line in frd_luk_007.
c06494/c06503 also open frd_itk_115, where the 'shopping' trip turns into eating around; 'going shopping' still fits.
c06553: kibun sookai rendered 'exhilarating' to keep clear of the glossary's 'refresh' gag term.
